name: paw-vs-paw
description: Pawville — a cozy virtual world for long-distance couples (React + TypeScript + Vite + Supabase), home of Paw vs Paw, PawType, Cat Boxing, Cat Battleship, Memory Paws, Whack-a-Cat, Puzzle Garden and Paw Snap. Milestone 6: regions, quests, Racon, installable PWA/Android/desktop.

scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.desktop:start: npm run build && cd desktop && npm install && npm start
scripts.desktop:win: npm run build && cd desktop && npm install && npm run dist:win
